descriptionChirho: Active causative destruction or ruination of something, used in the Piel stem across various inflections including infinitive, participle, perfect, and imperfect.
Intransitive or stative sense of acting corruptly, ruining, or offending, used in the Qal stem including the infinitive absolute functioning adverbially.
Passive sense of being destroyed, ruined, broken, or corrupted, expressed through both the Nifal and Pual stems.
